description: MA Lighting grandMA2 onPC v3.9.63.6 — full show control software running via Wine. Connects to grandMA2 consoles and NPUs over MA-Net2.
notes: Requires Docker Run Config Override: {"network_mode": "host", "user": "root"} — host networking is mandatory for MA-Net2 multicast console discovery (UDP 6549). Art-Net on UDP 8000, sACN on UDP 5568. GrandMA2 onPC launches automatically on desktop open.

go.cmd: bash -c "WINEPREFIX=/home/kasm-user/.wine wine '/home/kasm-user/.wine/drive_c/Program Files (x86)/MA Lighting Technologies/grandMA2 onPC/grandMA2 onPC.exe'"
